plugin.title: Simple SEO
plugin.description: Metadata and structured data for pages and content.

phrases.heading: Simple SEO
phrases.metadata_help: Empty fields use automatic values. Content pages use their content type settings. All language tabs are saved together.
phrases.title: Title
phrases.placeholder_help: Click a placeholder to insert it into the last focused field. Content fields are available by their system names. Reserved values such as title and canonical_url are supplied by SEO.
phrases.preview_help: Preview renders the current form without saving. FAQ, lists and breadcrumbs supplied by page plugins appear only on the live page. The preview page must match the item's route.
phrases.schema_help: Use valid JSON with quoted placeholders: "headline": "{{article_title}}". An exact placeholder preserves arrays and numeric values. Empty values are omitted. Schemas are shared by all languages in this domain.
phrases.confirm_restore: Restore the original preset? Current schema edits will be lost.
phrases.invalid_key: Use a schema key beginning with a lowercase letter, followed by letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
phrases.key_exists: A schema with this key already exists.
phrases.select_item: Select an item of this content type for preview.
phrases.schema_in_use: This schema is assigned to pages or content types. Remove its assignments before deleting it.
phrases.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this editor?
phrases.sitemap_help: Generate a static XML sitemap for a selected domain.
phrases.exclude_languages_help: Active system languages excluded from this domain sitemap.
phrases.sitemap_output_help: Path relative to the public root. Large sitemaps are split beside this file automatically.
phrases.sitemap_generated: Sitemap generated: %d URLs, %d files. Main file: %s
phrases.sitemap_not_generated: The sitemap file has not been generated yet.
